name: GD Pathfinder
description: Finds the inputs to beat a level, then plays them.

time-limit.name: Search time limit
time-limit.description: Seconds the search may run before giving up.

lean-search.name: Search on a copy without decoration
lean-search.description: Search big levels on a copy with only the gameplay objects, then verify and play the path on the real level. Other mods' gameplay hooks are turned off while the copy is searched.

fast-restore.name: Fast state restore (experimental)
fast-restore.description: Only reset the objects triggers can move when going back to a searched state. Much faster on decorated levels, but can desync on levels with lots of moving objects.

segment-seconds.name: Segment length (seconds)
segment-seconds.description: The level is solved this many seconds at a time, each segment continuing from the previous one. 0 solves the whole level in one search.

resume-saved.name: Continue from saved progress
resume-saved.description: When a level has a saved partial path, carry on from the furthest verified point instead of solving from the start. Untick to force a fresh search.

show-search.name: Show the level while searching
show-search.description: Keep rendering the level while the bot searches. Off hides it, which roughly doubles the search speed.

use-cache.name: Use cached paths
use-cache.description: Play a previously found path for the same level instead of searching again.

memory-limit.name: Search memory (MB)
memory-limit.description: How much the game process may grow while searching before the search starts dropping states. Capped automatically to the memory the machine actually has free, so a big number here is a ceiling, not a reservation.

look-ahead-seconds.name: Look-ahead (seconds)
look-ahead-seconds.description: How far the bot checks ahead before it decides a press will kill it, in seconds. 0 lets it pick automatically (about 0.02-0.03s). Higher catches deaths earlier but costs search speed. Only affects ship, UFO, wave and spider sections.

refuse-fatal-clicks.name: Refuse clicks it thinks will kill it
refuse-fatal-clicks.description: Stops the bot from even trying a press its look-ahead predicts is fatal, instead of trying it last. WARNING: the prediction is approximate, so when it is wrong the bot throws away the only route through a section and can get permanently stuck. Leave off unless testing.
